title: Project Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Project Engineer - Data Centre ConstructionJLL Project and Development ServicesPosition OverviewThe Project Engineer will support the execution and delivery of the Adani Data Centre project in Dholera, working under JLL's Project and Development Services division. This role requires hands-on involvement in managing day-to-day construction activities, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and ensuring project objectives are met in terms of quality, schedule, and budget for this critical mission-critical facility.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesConstruction Management & Coordination
  
Manage daily construction activities for the data centre project, ensuring work progresses according to approved schedules and specifications. Coordinate with multiple contractors and subcontractors including civil, structural, MEP, electrical, and specialty data centre systems contractors. Conduct daily site walks to monitor work quality, progress, safety compliance, and adherence to project standards. Facilitate coordination meetings with contractors to resolve interface issues and maintain workflow efficiency.
  
Technical Documentation & Submittals
  
Review contractor submittals including shop drawings, material data sheets, method statements, and equipment specifications for compliance with design intent and project requirements. Track submittal status and ensure timely review and approval cycles to prevent delays. Maintain comprehensive project documentation including RFIs, site instructions, daily reports, progress photographs, and as-built records. Prepare and distribute meeting minutes, site inspection reports, and progress updates to project stakeholders.
  
Schedule Monitoring & Progress Tracking
  
Monitor construction progress against the project baseline schedule and identify potential delays or critical path impacts. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports detailing completed activities, upcoming milestones, and schedule variance analysis. Coordinate with contractors to develop recovery plans when schedule deviations occur. Update project schedules based on actual site conditions and communicate changes to the project management team.
  
Quality Control & Compliance
  
Conduct inspections of ongoing work to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards specific to data centre construction. Coordinate with the QAQC team to ensure proper testing and commissioning procedures for critical systems including raised floor, cooling infrastructure, power distribution, and fire suppression systems. Verify that materials delivered to site match approved specifications and maintain material traceability records.
  
Budget Management Support
  
Track and monitor project costs by reviewing contractor invoices, payment applications, and change order proposals. Assist in preparing cost forecasts, budget variance reports, and expenditure tracking documents. Identify potential cost-saving opportunities and value engineering options without compromising project quality or functionality.
  
Data Centre-Specific Coordination
  
Coordinate installation and testing of mission-critical data centre infrastructure including UPS systems, generator sets, precision cooling units, electrical distribution equipment, and monitoring systems. Ensure proper coordination between raised floor installation, cable management systems, and equipment placement. Facilitate coordination between IT infrastructure consultants, equipment vendors, and installation contractors to ensure seamless integration of data centre systems.
  
Stakeholder Communication
  
Serve as primary on-site liaison between JLL project management, Adani stakeholders, design consultants, contractors, and local authorities. Communicate project status, issues, and requirements clearly and promptly to all relevant parties. Participate in client meetings and site walkthroughs, presenting project progress and addressing concerns professionally.
  
Regulatory & Statutory Compliance
  
Ensure all construction activities comply with local building codes, Gujarat state regulations, and statutory requirements applicable to the Dholera Special Investment Region. Coordinate with local authorities for inspections, approvals, and statutory clearances required during construction. Maintain updated knowledge of special requirements for data centre facilities including fire safety, electrical safety, and environmental compliance.
  
Site Safety Management
  
Support the project safety team in implementing and monitoring site safety protocols and procedures. Participate in safety inspections and toolbox talks to promote a safety-first culture on site. Ensure contractors maintain required safety equipment, signage, and emergency response procedures. Report safety incidents and near-misses promptly and participate in incident investigations.
  
Required QualificationsEducation & Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline required. Minimum 4-6 years of experience in construction project management or site engineering roles. Prior experience with data centre, critical facility, or industrial construction projects highly preferred. Experience working on large-scale infrastructure projects in India required.
  
Technical Competencies
  
Strong understanding of construction methods, sequencing, and coordination for multi-disciplinary projects. Knowledge of data centre infrastructure components including power systems, cooling systems, raised floors, and cable management. Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, MEP, and electrical drawings. Familiarity with construction contracts, specifications, and standard industry practices.
  
Software Proficiency
  
Proficient in MS Project or Primavera P6 for schedule tracking and analysis. Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reporting and documentation. Experience with project management software and document control systems. Knowledge of BIM coordination tools (Navisworks, BIM 360) is advantageous.
  
Professional Skills
  
Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple work fronts simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to make sound decisions under pressure. Effective communication skills in English and Hindi (knowledge of Gujarati is beneficial). Detail-oriented with strong documentation and record-keeping capabilities. Team player with ability to work collaboratively in a diverse, multi-cultural environment.
  
Regulatory Knowledge
  
Understanding of Indian building codes, NBC provisions, and local regulatory requirements. Familiarity with Gujarat state construction regulations and Dholera Special Investment Region guidelines. Knowledge of data centre standards including Uptime Institute Tier classifications, TIA-942, and relevant IS codes.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. title: QAQC Lead
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Description:** QA/QC LeadJLL Projects and Development Services
  
Data Centre Project, Dholera
  
  
Position SummaryQA/QC Lead responsible for establishing and managing comprehensive quality assurance and quality control programs for mission-critical data centre in Dholera. Ensure all construction activities, materials, and installations meet specified standards, design requirements, and international data centre quality benchmarks across civil, structural, architectural, and MEP disciplines.
  
  
Key ResponsibilitiesQuality Management System Development
  
Develop and implement project-specific Quality Management Plan (QMP) aligned with ISO 9001 and JLL standards
  
Establish Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for all construction activities and MEP installations
  
Create quality procedures, checklists, and acceptance criteria for critical work activities
  
Define hold points, witness points, and mandatory inspection stages across all disciplines
  
Develop non-conformance management system including NCR procedures and disposition protocols
  
Establish document control procedures for quality records, test certificates, and as-built documentation
  
Set quality KPIs and metrics for contractor performance monitoring
  
Quality Planning & Standards Compliance
  
Review design drawings, specifications, and technical standards to establish quality requirements
  
Ensure compliance with Indian codes (IS standards, NBC), international data centre standards (Uptime Institute, TIA-942), and manufacturer specifications
  
Develop material approval procedures and approved vendor/manufacturer lists
  
Establish sampling and testing frequencies per relevant codes and project requirements
  
Coordinate quality requirements with design consultants and specialty contractors
  
Define quality deliverables and submission schedules for all project phases
  
Material Quality Control
  
Review and approve contractor material submittals, product data sheets, and technical documentation
  
Verify material certifications, test certificates, and compliance documentation
  
Conduct material inspection at manufacturer facilities and upon site delivery
  
Monitor material storage conditions to prevent damage and deterioration
  
Maintain material traceability records for critical components
  
Coordinate third-party testing for structural materials (cement, steel, aggregates, concrete)
  
Approve material substitutions with engineering and client concurrence
  
Construction Quality Inspection & Monitoring
  
Conduct daily quality inspections across all construction zones and work fronts
  
Verify workmanship quality against approved method statements and specifications
  
Monitor dimensional accuracy, alignment, leveling, and tolerances per design requirements
  
Inspect civil works including excavation, formwork, reinforcement, concrete works, and finishing
  
Oversee structural steel fabrication and erection quality including welding inspection
  
Monitor architectural finishes, false ceiling, flooring, and facade installation quality
  
Inspect MEP installations including mechanical equipment, piping, ductwork, electrical conduits, cable trays, and instrumentation
  
Testing & Commissioning Support
  
Coordinate factory acceptance tests (FAT) for critical equipment and systems
  
Witness site acceptance tests (SAT) for mechanical, electrical, and fire protection systems
  
Oversee non-destructive testing (NDT) including radiography, ultrasonic testing, and dye penetrant testing
  
Monitor hydrostatic testing, pressure testing, and leak testing of piping systems
  
Coordinate load testing of structural elements, slabs, and lifting equipment
  
Verify pre-commissioning activities including flushing, cleaning, and functional checks
  
Participate in integrated systems testing and performance verification
  
Ensure test documentation completeness and compliance with specifications
  
Non-Conformance Management
  
Identify and document non-conformances through inspections and testing
  
Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) to contractors with clear disposition requirements
  
Track corrective actions and verify completion through re-inspection
  
Escalate major non-conformances to project management and client representatives
  
Maintain NCR register and trend analysis for quality improvement
  
Coordinate rework, repair, or replacement of defective work
  
Ensure proper documentation of corrective actions and acceptance
  
Contractor Quality Management
  
Review and approve contractor Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) plans
  
Evaluate contractor QC team qualifications and competency
  
Monitor contractor self-inspection programs and internal quality audits
  
Conduct joint inspections with contractor QC personnel
  
Review contractor test results, inspection reports, and quality records
  
Verify contractor compliance with approved ITPs and quality procedures
  
Issue quality performance ratings and non-compliance notices
  
Documentation & Reporting
  
Maintain comprehensive quality records including inspection reports, test results, and certificates
  
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly quality reports with statistical analysis
  
Document punch list items and track completion through handover
  
Compile as-built documentation including drawings, O&M manuals, and warranties
  
Maintain photographic records of construction progress and quality issues
  
Prepare quality dossiers for handover to client and operations team
  
Archive quality documentation per contract and regulatory requirements
  
Audits & Continuous Improvement
  
Conduct internal quality audits of contractor work and site processes
  
Coordinate third-party quality audits and regulatory inspections
  
Facilitate client quality inspections and address observations promptly
  
Implement lessons learned and best practices from quality issues
  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality outcomes
  
Benchmark quality performance against industry standards
  
Required QualificationsEducation & Certification
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering
  
ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification preferred
  
CQM (Certified Quality Manager) or CQE (Certified Quality Engineer) certification advantageous
  
ASNT Level II or PCN certification for NDT inspection preferred
  
Training in welding inspection (CSWIP/AWS) beneficial
  
Experience
  
10-12 years in quality management with 6+ years in large-scale construction projects
  
Minimum 3 years experience in mission-critical facilities, industrial, or complex commercial projects
  
Proven track record managing quality across civil, structural, architectural, and MEP disciplines
  
Experience with data centre, pharmaceutical, or high-tech facility construction strongly preferred
  
Knowledge of Indian standards (IS codes) and international quality standards
  
Technical Expertise
  
Deep understanding of construction quality control methods and inspection techniques
  
Strong knowledge of material testing procedures and acceptance criteria
  
Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings across all disciplines
  
Understanding of welding standards, NDT methods, and structural inspection
  
Familiarity with MEP installation standards and commissioning protocols
  
Knowledge of concrete technology, soil mechanics, and structural materials
  
Understanding of quality management systems (ISO 9001, TQM principles)
  
Skills & Competencies
  
Excellent attention to detail and systematic inspection approach
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  
Effective communication skills in English and Hindi (written and verbal)
  
Assertiveness in enforcing quality standards diplomatically
  
Proficiency in MS Office, quality management software, and inspection apps
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure
  
Strong documentation and report writing capabilities
  
Team leadership and contractor management skills
  
Key AttributesUncompromising commitment to quality excellence
  
Proactive identification of quality risks before they materialize
  
Collaborative approach while maintaining independent quality oversight
  
Systematic and methodical work approach
  
Professional integrity and ethical conduct
  
Continuous learning mindset
  
Client-focused attitude with service orientation
  
Typical DeliverablesProject Quality Management Plan (QMP)
  
Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for all activities
  
Material approval register and submittals log
  
Daily quality inspection reports
  
Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and closure records
  
Test result compilations and certifications
  
Weekly and monthly quality performance reports
  
Punch list and defects tracking reports
  
Quality audit reports and CAPA registers
  
As-built quality documentation dossier
  
  
Working ConditionsBased full-time at project site in Dholera, Gujarat with extensive field presence across construction zones. Working hours typically 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM with flexibility for critical inspections, testing activities, and concrete pours. Regular site walks and climbing required in all weather conditions. Occasional travel to manufacturer facilities for FAT and vendor inspections. Appropriate PPE mandatory for all site activities.
  
Reporting StructureReports to Project Director/Senior Project Manager for Data Centre project with functional reporting to JLL's Regional Quality Manager. Direct oversight of quality engineers, quality inspectors, and quality coordinators. Interfaces with contractor QC managers, consultants, third-party testing agencies, and client quality representatives.
  
Key Performance IndicatorsZero critical non-conformances at handover
  
Right-first-time percentage >95%
  
NCR closure within agreed timelines
  
Material approval turnaround time compliance
  
Inspection completion rate per ITP schedule
  
Client audit findings and satisfaction ratings
  
Punch list completion before substantial completion
  
Quality documentation completeness at handover

description:
**Job Title**

**Counter Staff / Senior Counter Staff**

Branch Operations Head / Service In-charge

  

**Location**

**Blue Dart Retail Counter / Branch**

  

**Travel Required**

**25%** **50%** **75%**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

**Position Overview:**

The Counter Executive / Senior Counter Executive serves as the first point of contact for walk-in customers at Blue Dart retail counters, delivering a professional, efficient and customer-centric service experience. The role is responsible for assisting customers with shipment bookings, service enquiries, documentation, payment processing and shipment tracking while ensuring a seamless and positive customer experience.

Reporting to the Branch Operations Head or Service In-charge, the incumbent represents the Blue Dart brand through courteous customer interactions, operational accuracy and service excellence. The role contributes directly to customer satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), retail revenue growth and customer retention by consistently delivering high-quality service and promoting appropriate logistics solutions.

**Job Purpose:**

To provide an exceptional customer experience at Blue Dart retail counters by accurately processing customer shipments, addressing enquiries, promoting relevant services and ensuring efficient counter operations while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, operational accuracy and customer satisfaction.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Customer Service & Retail Counter Operations**

* Welcome walk-in customers professionally and provide prompt, courteous and personalised service.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend the most appropriate Blue Dart products and services.

title: System Support Administrator
description:
SUMMARY:

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled System Support Administrator with around 1\.5 years of experience to join our IT team. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in IT support, system troubleshooting, basic networking, and user administration. Candidates who have completed relevant IT courses or certifications and are looking to grow their career in system and network administration are encouraged to apply.

The candidate will be responsible for providing day\-to\-day technical support, maintaining IT systems, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and assisting with network and security\-related tasks.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field is preferred., Relevant certifications and practical experience may also be considered.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

1 to 2 years of experience in IT Support, System Support, Desktop Support, or a similar role.

Good understanding of Windows operating systems and basic troubleshooting.

Basic knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, and firewalls.

Basic knowledge of computer hardware, peripherals, printers, and troubleshooting.

Familiarity with user account and access management.

Basic understanding of antivirus, endpoint security, and system updates.

Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to document technical issues and resolutions clearly.

Ability to work independently as well as with a team.

CERTIFICATIONS:

CompTIA A\+

CompTIA Network\+

Microsoft Windows / Microsoft 365 Administration

CCNA or basic networking certification

Linux Fundamentals / Linux Administration

IT Support / System Administration courses

Any other relevant IT infrastructure or networking certification

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Provide first\-level technical support to employees for hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity\-related issues. Diagnose and resolve common desktop, laptop, printer, application, and operating system problems. Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, software applications, and IT hardware. Set up computers, user accounts, email accounts, peripherals, and other IT resources for new and existing employees. Perform routine system updates, software installations, patches, and basic backups. Monitor system health and performance and escalate complex issues when required. Assist with the configuration and maintenance of network devices such as routers, switches, access points, and firewalls. Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and internet connectivity issues. Assist in maintaining basic network and endpoint security, including antivirus, firewall, VPN, and access\-control configurations. Manage user access and permissions in accordance with company policies. Maintain an inventory of IT assets, systems, and software licenses. Maintain proper documentation of support tickets, technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions. Follow IT security, backup, access\-control, and data protection procedures. Coordinate with senior IT/System Administrators or external vendors for issues requiring advanced technical support. Provide basic guidance and training to users on IT systems, applications, and security best practices.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

1 to 2 years of practical IT/System Support experience. Strong interest in System Administration, Networking, and IT Infrastructure. Willingness to learn and work with new technologies. Good analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Responsible, proactive, and customer\-focused approach. Candidates with relevant courses, certifications, labs, or hands\-on projects will be considered positively.
